breakdown.description: `dc2` is treated as the interstitial-containing defect complex even though it is built without the H interstitial.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly builds `dc2` as a defect complex from the O-on-N substitution, the Ga vacancy, AND the H interstitial, matching the ground truth. It no longer treats `dc2` as built without the H interstitial (the original inconsistency). The interstitial-containing properties are computed from this correctly constructed `dc2`.
